source.evidence_role: single-platform empirical sensitivity envelope, not a motor population

rho_interval_rule: min/max b over the four frozen correlated vertices divided by nominal_pwm_gain
edge_convention: W[i,j]>0 means follower i receives follower j; target is column N

metric_problem.objective: maximize common Euclidean eigenvalue margin over all rho corners

authorization.exploratory_metric_preflight_supported: true only if source bindings, all 32 corners for all 3 graphs, solver status, minimum g, Euclidean margin and generalized margin pass

stop_rules: do not narrow the rho interval after observing the result
do not replace a common per-graph G with corner-specific metrics
do not drop a graph or rho corner
do not reinterpret the four vertices as independent motors or a confidence region
do not run network trajectories under this preflight protocol
